# name: The day-keepers cast lots; the people of wood and the flood
# title: Chi cutun ibi Hunahpu Vuch
# fols: fols. 4r–5r
“Chi cutun ibi, Hunahpu Vuch, Hunahpu Vtiu, camul Alom, camul Ꜭaholom, Nimac, Nima Ꜯyꜩ, ahcuval, ahyamanic, ahchut, ahꜩalam, Ah Raxa Lac, Ah Raxa Ꜩel, ahꜫol, Ahtoltecat, Ratit Ꜫih, Ratit Zac, quix vꜭhaxic rumal caꜯac, cabit. Chi mala chi ixim, chi ꜩite; xa chi banatahic, xa pu chel apanoc chi cahah, chi ca cotah puch vchi, vvach che?” xe vꜭhaxic e ahꜫih.

Cate puch vcahic vꜫihiloxic ri xmalic chi ixim, chi ꜩite. “Ꜫih, bit!” xeꜭha cu ri hun atit, hun mama chiquech. Are ri mama, are ahꜩite, Xpiyacoc vbi; are cu ri atit, ahꜫih, ahbit, Chiracan Xmucane vbi.

Xeꜭha cut, ta xqui tiquiba ꜫih: “Xa chu culu, xa pu chu rico; cha byih, ca ta ca xiquin, caꜭhauic, caꜩihon tah, xa chu culu ri che chahauaxic, chi cotox puch cumal Ahꜯac, Ahbit, ve are ꜩucul, cool, ta chavaxoc, ta zaquiroc.”

“At ixim, at ꜩite, at ꜫih, at bit, cat choconic, cat taquentah,” xꜭha chire ixim, ꜩite, ꜫih, bit. “Cat quix la vloc, at Vꜭux Cah; ma ca hizah vchi, vvach Tepeu, Ꜫucumaꜩ.”

Xeꜭha, ta xqui bih cut vzuculiquil: “Vꜩ are chuxoc ri i poy, aham che, chi ꜭhauic, chi ꜩihon bala chuvach vleu.” “Ta chuxoc,” xeꜭha cut, ta xqui bih. Huzuc xbanic poy, aham che; xe vinac vachinic, xe vinac ꜩihonic puch; are vinaquil vvach vleu.

Xe vxic, xe poꜫic, xe mealanic, xe ꜭaholanic ri poy, aham che; ma cu habi qui ꜭux, ma pu habi qui naoh; mavi natal cahꜯac, cahbit. Xa loc xe binic, xe chacanic.

Mavi xqui natah chic ri Vꜭux Cah; quehe cut xe pah chi vi. Xa vtihtobexic, xa pu vvababexic chi vinac. Que ꜭhau nabec, xa chaquih qui vach; mana zonol cacan, qui ꜫab; ma habi qui quiquel, qui comahil; ma habi qui ticoval, qui cabchiyal; chaquih coꜩ ꜭoh qui vach; ca pichipoh cacan, qui cab; ca ieioh qui tiohil.

Quehe cut mavi xe nau chi vi chuvach Ꜯacol, Bitol, alai quech, ꜭuxlaai quech. E nabe ꜩaꜩ chi vinac xe vxic varal chuvach vleu.

Cate cut qui quyzic chic, qui mayxic, qui cutuxic puch; xe camizax chic poy, aham che.

Ta xnohix qui butic rumal Vꜭux Cah; nima butic xbanic, xpe pa qui vi ri e poy, e aham che. Ꜩite vtiohil ri achih, ta xahaxic rumal Ꜯacol, Bitol; ixoc zibac cut vtiohil ixoc xrah oquic rumal Ꜯacol, Bitol. Mavi xe nauic, ma pu xeꜭhauic chuvach cahꜯac, cahbit, banol que, vinaquirizay quech.

Quehe cut qui camizaxic; xe butic; xpe nima ꜫol chila chicah. Xecotcovach vbi xcotin vloc vbac qui vach; xe pe Camaloꜩ, xcupin vla qui holom; xpe Coꜩbalam, xtio qui tiohil; xpe Tucumbalam, xtucuuic, xquichouic qui baquil, qui bochil; xcahixic, xmuchulixic qui baquil, cahizabal qui vach.

Rumal mavi qui nauic chuvach qui chuch, chuvach puch qui cahau, ri Vꜭux Cah, Huracan vbi; cumal xꜫecumaric vvach vleu, xticaric ꜫecal hab, ꜫihil hab, acabal hab.

Xoc vla chuti chicop, nima chicop; xcut qui vach rumal che, abah. Xꜭhauic ronohel qui quebal, qui xot, qui lac, qui boh, qui ꜩi, qui caa, haruh pala ronohel; xcute qui vach.
